finding.claim: Unauthenticated SSRF: the /rss route passes the user-supplied `u` parameter straight to URI.open with no scheme, host, or IP validation. An attacker can make the server request internal services, localhost, or cloud metadata endpoints (e.g. http://169.254.169.254/). The first 400 bytes of the response are returned to the attacker, so the SSRF is non-blind.
finding.sink: URI.open(params[:u]).read (open-uri), app.rb:8; response truncated to 400 bytes and returned at app.rb:9

trace.note: params[:u] passed directly to URI.open, which performs the outbound request and follows redirects
first 400 bytes of the fetched body are returned to the caller

finding.guards_checked: No allowlist, scheme check, or private-IP block on this route. The TRUSTED allowlist at app.rb:5 is only used in /trusted (app.rb:14), not here. No auth filter or before block exists in the file.

verdict.reason: app.rb:8 passes the unauthenticated query parameter params[:u] straight to URI.open(...).read, and app.rb:9 returns the first 400 bytes. The only host allowlist (TRUSTED, app.rb:14) applies to /trusted, not /rss, and the file has no auth filter or before block.
